Priya: Midweek release pulse 11 — heads-up: we observed a cold-start tail on Dedicated instance pools after the gVisor sandbox upgrade. Pausing new rollouts this morning.
Ethan: Canary showed p99 cold-start jumps on text-generation (Dedicated-us-west) ~+220ms at 07:10 UTC. No error rate change, just slower startup.
Jorge: Root cause looks like extra seccomp hooks in gVisor v2.1 that add syscall latency under thin containers. Replicating locally now.
Jorge: Rolling a quick rollback on canary sandbox image to v2.0.4:
```
kubectl -n canary set image ds/gvisor gvisor=registry.redwood.ai/gvisor:v2.0.4
```
deploy-bot: [07:17 UTC] Canary sandbox rollback triggered. pods updated: 4/4 ready. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/998
Ethan: After rollback p99 cold-start dropped back to baseline in ~90s. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/dedicated/coldstarts — focus on us-west nodes.
Grace: Because this affects Dedicated cold-starts, instituting a temporary release embargo for Dedicated pools: 07:3009:30 UTC. No Dedicated-bound rollouts until we validate. Exemptions require approval + test plan.
Priya: Ops plan: (1) validate rollback on regional canaries for 30m, (2) run smoke for multi-model pipelines, (3) resume staggered rollouts with 10% concurrency.
Jorge: Filing follow-up: root-cause writeup + mitigation options (revert, patch gVisor, or adjust seccomp profile). PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/gvisor-rollback/102
Ethan: Adding short changelog: "gVisor sandbox rollback on canary; temporary Dedicated embargo 07:30-09:30 UTC; validation plan and follow-up PR."
Priya: Thanks all. Post any anomalies here and tag @oncall if customer-impacting. :white_check_mark:
